description: This file defines the Workspace entity class for Drupal, including its properties, behaviors, and lifecycle methods within the workspaces module.

classes.name: Workspace
classes.description: Represents a workspace entity with properties like ID, label, owner, parent, provider, and timestamps, including methods for lifecycle management and property access.

methods.name: baseFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Defines the base fields for the Workspace entity, including ID, label, owner, parent, provider, and timestamps.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes the workspace using the workspaces operation factory.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the workspace.

methods.name: setCreatedTime
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the workspace.

methods.name: hasParent
methods.description: Checks if the workspace has a parent workspace.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Retrieves the workspace provider instance associated with this workspace.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Handles actions after saving the workspace, such as copying parent associations and resetting cache.

methods.name: preDelete
methods.description: Prevents deletion if the workspace has descendants.

methods.name: postDelete
methods.description: Handles cleanup after deletion, including switching active workspace if needed and purging revisions.
